author: James Pero
title: Apple’s Next Vision Pro May Come Sooner Than You Think, but With One Big Letdown
description: A new Vision Pro may be upon us, but maybe not the one you're hoping for.
content: It may feel like Apple has given up on its used car-priced “spatial computer,” the Vision Pro, but according to a report from Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman, the iPhone maker’s next-gen headset might arrive… [+2522 chars]
